content: Microsoft is now rolling out Automatic Super Resolution (Auto SR), an upscaling technology that competes with Nvidia’s DLSS, for the Xbox Ally X, Xbox Ally X20, and select Windows Copilot Plus PCs, the company announced today. Auto SR is also getting some new features alongside this official release. In April, Microsoft started testing Auto SR on the Xbox Ally X, but you could only use it while docked. The full release of Auto SR announced today now works while you’re playing handheld and running on battery, and it also supports games running at 1080p. Microsoft does note that playing in handheld and at 1080p might lead to performance that “may not be as optimal as other configurations,” but says you’ll see visual improvements “especially in older games.” Previously, Auto SR was also limited to framerates of “around” 60 to 75fps, but support for a new Auto SR Performance mode will allow you to hit framerates of up to 120fps. The Performance mode, and new compatibility with Auto HDR, will be available through Windows updates.
chineseTitle: 微软的 DLSS 竞争对手已推出 Xbox Ally X，可在手持模式下工作

chineseContent: 微软今天宣布，现在正在为 Xbox Ally X、Xbox Ally X20 和部分 Windows Copilot Plus PC 推出自动超级分辨率 (Auto SR)，这是一种与 Nvidia 的 DLSS 竞争的升级技术。在此正式版本发布的同时，Auto SR 还获得了一些新功能。 4 月份，微软开始在 Xbox Ally X 上测试 Auto SR，但你只能在连接时使用它。今天发布的 Auto SR 完整版本现在可以在您使用电池运行手持游戏时运行，并且还支持以 1080p 运行的游戏。微软确实指出，在手持设备和 1080p 下玩游戏可能会导致性能“可能不如其他配置那样最佳”，但表示你会看到视觉效果的改进“尤其是在旧游戏中”。此前，自动 SR 也仅限于“大约”60 至 75 fps 的帧速率，但对新的自动 SR 性能模式的支持将使您能够达到高达 120 fps 的帧速率。性能模式以及与自动 HDR 的新兼容性将通过 Windows 更新提供。
